findings.evidence: Basic.lean:42 `normLE (x : ℝ) : Finset ι := (finite_setOf_natCast_le N x).toFinset` vs PR:48 `heightLE (X : ℝ) := (F.finite_height_le X).toFinset`; Basic.lean:69-71 and PR:66-68 are the same `Filter.tendsto_atTop_finset_of_monotone … ⟨_, (mem_ _).mpr le_rfl⟩` term.
findings.fix: Generalise the existing carrier in Order/Northcott/Basic.lean once to a real height `h : ι → ℝ` with `[Northcott h]`, recover the natural case through `finite_setOf_natCast_le`, and define `heightLE` as that carrier applied to `F.height`. Delete the duplicated lemmas.
findings.issue: `heightLE`, `mem_heightLE`, `coe_heightLE`, `heightLE_mono` and `tendsto_heightLE_atTop` copy `normLE`, `mem_normLE`, `coe_normLE`, `normLE_mono` and `tendsto_normLE_atTop` (Order/Northcott/Basic.lean:42-71) with the same proofs; only `(N i : ℝ)` is replaced by a real height.

findings.evidence: Basic.lean:105 `∑ i ∈ normLE N x, w i` vs PR:72 `∑ i ∈ F.heightLE X, w i`; PR:262-266 the bridges `heightLE_ofNat`/`weightedCount_ofNat`.
findings.fix: Use the generalised `summatory` applied to `F.height`, or define `weightedCount` as it. Then the summatory lemmas (`summatory_add`, `summatory_mono`, `eventually_summatory_indicator_sub_eq`, …) carry over to families, and the `ofNat` bridge lemmas become `rfl` or can be deleted.
findings.issue: `weightedCount` and `weightedCount_apply` copy `summatory` and `summatory_apply` (Basic.lean:103-110), down to the `rw [summatory]` proof. `weightedCount_ofNat` and `heightLE_ofNat` exist only to show the two copies agree.

findings.evidence: Basic.lean:94-97 `normLE_eq_empty_of_lt … refine Finset.eq_empty_of_forall_notMem fun i hi ↦ … (hb i).trans (mem_normLE N |>.mp hi)` vs PR:150-151 the same term on `heightLE`.
findings.fix: After generalising the carrier, use the generalised `normLE_eq_empty_of_lt`: `simp [count, normLE_eq_empty_of_lt _ hb hX]`.
findings.issue: `count_eq_zero_of_lt` proves the empty-carrier step again in its own `have`; this is `normLE_eq_empty_of_lt` (Basic.lean:94) with the same `Finset.eq_empty_of_forall_notMem` proof.

summary: The real-height carrier and weighted count copy the existing `normLE`/`summatory` API declaration for declaration, with only the height type changed, so the library now has two parallel APIs joined by `ofNat` bridge lemmas. The other declarations are new and properly reuse Mathlib's Northcott and fibre-counting results.
